intentions.title: Give external authors a typed, ergonomic TypeScript SDK to construct PortableDoc papers without hand-writing JSON
intentions.evidence: sdk/src/blocks.ts defines a full Block union (heading, paragraph, ingress, pullquote, eyebrow, byline, list, callout, action, code, diagram, asciicast, image, table, divider, section) with one constructor function per type; sdk/src/paper.ts's Paper builder collects blocks and serializes the exact publish body the ingest endpoint accepts; sdk/src/index.ts barrels blocks/ops/paper/client into '@barkpark/bulldocs-sdk'.

intentions.title: Keep the SDK's block/op field names byte-identical to the Elixir renderer and patch engine so authored JSON never silently mismatches the server contract
intentions.evidence: blocks.ts header comment explicitly states field names mirror Barkpark.PortableDoc.Render.compose_block/2 (api/lib/barkpark/portable_doc/render.ex) exactly, calling out non-obvious traps ('code -> value, NOT lang/code'; 'diagram -> source, NOT mermaid'); ops.ts header states keys mirror Barkpark.PortableDoc.Patch and BulldocsIngestController.apply_op/2 exactly, with the 'op' discriminator being a hyphenated string not a camelCase tag.

intentions.title: Guarantee deterministic, reproducible block ids across SDK-generated documents (no wall-clock or randomness in output)
intentions.evidence: blocks.ts implements a monotonic __counter with nextBlockId() minting 'b1','b2',... and resetBlockIds() explicitly documented for test reproducibility, replacing any Date.now()/random-based id scheme; every block constructor calls withId(id) to auto-mint when the author omits one.

intentions.title: Support incremental, atomic document editing via a typed patch-op vocabulary (append/insert/patch/replace/remove/move) with optimistic concurrency
intentions.evidence: ops.ts defines Op union + constructors (appendBlock, insertAfter, patchBlock, replaceBlock, removeBlock, moveBlock) matching Barkpark.PortableDoc.Patch; client.ts's submitOps() batches all ops into one POST to /papers/{slug}/ops with an optional ifRev precondition guard that rejects the whole batch atomically on mismatch (precondition_failed).

intentions.title: Provide a minimal, dependency-light HTTP client for Bulldocs ingest that surfaces server errors as typed exceptions
intentions.evidence: client.ts's BulldocsClient wraps publish() and submitOps() over global fetch (injectable for tests), authenticates via Bearer ingestToken against RequireIngestToken-gated routes, and throws a typed BulldocsError carrying code/status/body parsed from the server's {error:{code,message}} shape on non-2xx responses.

intentions.title: Model rich inline text (marks, links, wikilinks, blockrefs, tags) as a ProseMirror-like Inline node tree while keeping the common case (plain string) ergonomic
intentions.evidence: blocks.ts defines the Inline union (InlineText, InlineStrong, InlineEm, InlineStrike, InlineUnderline, InlineCode, InlineLink, InlineWikilink, InlineBlockref, InlineTag) accepting bare strings as text leaves per compose_inline/2, plus an inlineContent() coercion helper used by every constructor taking string | Inline[].
